On The 5th Of January, 2026
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 58965 of 2025
 Sudharshan Kushwah @ Rajnish
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Harshvardhan Soni - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Ms. Sipra Gupta - Pl for respondent/State.
 Order

This petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of Cr.P.C/528 of BNSS, 2023 for quashment of order dated 17-11-2025 passed in SC No. 630/2021 by Additional Sessions Judge,
Bhopal by which the learned trial court has rejected the application filed by the petitioner under Section 311 of CRPC.

2. On the basis of complaint, FIR was lodged against the petitioner under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC and under Sections 5/6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and the trial is pending before the Additional Sessions Judge, Bhopal.
3. It is submitted that after cross-examination of the prosecutrix, the petitioner came to know that the victim was married and at the time of incident she is 19 years old.

This fact needs to be cross-examined NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:200 2 MCRC-58965-2025 again from victim and therefore, he moved an application to recall the complainant in order to examine the complainant regarding her age and marriage.

4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner has recently came to know that the complainant has married 03 years ago and therefore, the petitioner moved an application under Section 311 of CRPC for recalling the complainant as on this fact the cross-examination of prosecutrix is necessary to protect the rights of the petitioner.
He further submits that the trial Court without appreciating the material facts has rejected the application filed by the petitioner.

5. Heard the parties and perused the record.

sentences.text: As regards the age of victim, she has already been cross- examined by the petitioner at paragraph-12.
As far as marriage of victim is concerned, except the photographs, which is insufficient, no evidence has been produced by the petitioner to show that the victim has married 3 years ago.

The question regarding previous marriage of the victim and marriage took place after recording the statement, is not a fact related to consent or in disagreement of victim nor will the said fact will have any impact on the entire case of the prosecution for the conclusion of trial in context of Section 48, Sections 64 to 71 and 74 to 78 of the Evidence Act.
Since the prosecutrix/victim has been cross-examined on the point of her age and therefore, again cross-examination on the marriage is not material in this case.

The trial court has not committed any error in NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:200 3 MCRC-58965-2025 rejecting the application filed by the petitioner under Section 311 of Cr.PC.
7.
In view of the aforesaid discussion, this Court is of the considered opinion that no case for interference is made out.
The impugned order does not suffer from infirmity calling for exercise of inherent powers under Section 528 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 482 of CrPC, 1973).
8. Accordingly, the petition sans merit and is hereby dismissed.

(B. P. SHARMA) JUDGE PG Sudharshan Kushwah @ Rajnish vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35057903/
